description:
Configure the 'TESTCAMP' campaign to be FCC TCPA Safe Harbor compliant. Navigate to the campaign detail view and update the following Drop/Safe Harbor settings:

1. Drop Call Seconds: 5
2. Safe Harbor Extension: 8300
3. Safe Harbor Message: 'This call is from Acme Insurance Services. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please call us back toll free at 1-800-555-0199. Thank you.'
4. Drop Lockout Time: 3 minutes
5. Safe Harbor Audio Field: DISABLED

Ensure you submit the changes so they are saved.
